senses.gloss:
औचित्यम्,
औचिती [उचित-ष्यञ् यलोपे ङीष्] 
__1 Aptness, fitness, propriety, suitableness. 
__2 Congruity or fitness, as one of the several circumstances which determine the exact meaning of a word in a sentence (such as संयोग, वियोग &c.); सामर्थ्यमौचिती देशः कालो व्यक्तिः स्वरादयः [[S. D. 2]]; in the example पातु वो दयितामुखम् there is औचिती or fitness in taking मुख to mean सांमुख्यम् (meeting) instead of आननम्. 
__3 Habituation. 
-Comp. 
-अलङ्कारः N. of a work.
